title: StandardShippingRate - Data API
description: Standard shipping rate for a store. This object is available in API version 59.0 and later.

ConditionFactor.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ConditionFactor.description: Conditions that affect the shipping rate. Possible values are: OrderPriceFactor—Condition based on the order price value. OrderWeightFactor—Condition based on delivery weight. This value is available in API version 62.0 and later.

ConditionRangeMax.description: Maximum value of the shipping rate condition.

ConditionRangeMin.description: Minimum value of the shipping rate condition. This value can't be negative.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Currency ISO code of the cart. Possible values are: EUR—Euro USD—U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: Name of the standard shipping rate.

Price.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort, Update

ShippingCarrierMethodId.description: ID of the shipping service carrier method. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later. This field is a relationship field.

ShippingZoneId.description: ID of the shipping zone. This field is a relationship field.

TransitTimeMax.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TransitTimeMax.description: Maximum value of the shipping transit time. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

TransitTimeMin.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TransitTimeMin.description: Minimum value of the shipping transit time. This value can't be negative. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

TransitTimeUnit.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TransitTimeUnit.description: Unit of value for shipping transit time. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later. Possible values are: Days Hours Weeks

WeightUnit.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
WeightUnit.description: Unit of measurement for the weight of the cart items. This field is available in API version 62.0 and later. Possible values are: Grams Kilograms Ounces Pounds
